reviewer: Independent asset reviewer, separate from implementer
approval_scope: Original editable generic static scene, explicit metadata-only bindings and local fixture guards. This is not laboratory execution, validated scientific simulation, physical safety certification, legal advice or public-publishing authorization.

resolved_findings.finding: Initial GLBs contained unintended second scenes; display GLB also contained the six apparatus groups, and main GLB contained an extra studio floor.
resolved_findings.resolution: Final exports use active-scene isolation; both independently decoded exports contain exactly one intended scene, with no extra floors, cross-scene assets, or orphan nodes.

resolved_findings.finding: Initial fixture accepted blank setup, plate and wavelength identifiers.
resolved_findings.resolution: Receipt validates all ten identity fields as nonempty, non-whitespace strings; method and direct-state invalid values are covered by regression tests.

resolved_findings.finding: Mixed valid/invalid change_setup input could mutate plate before raising and retain stale calibration.
resolved_findings.resolution: Prevalidation makes rejected multi-field changes atomic. Valid changes invalidate calibration; saved calibration context rejects direct valid-ID configuration mutation. Regression tests pass.

resolved_findings.finding: A successful metadata sample switch previously left the clamp observation reusable; a second switch or re-verification could reuse the previous cycle.
resolved_findings.resolution: Every successful switch consumes the current verified clamp cycle. A new CLAMP and independent positive VERIFY_CLAMP are required for each subsequent switch. A fresh command invalidates previous observation; initial verification without a command and re-verification of consumed cycles are blocked.

resolved_findings.finding: Initial metadata guard allowed CLAMP/VERIFY_CLAMP/SWITCH_SAMPLE while the cartridge was undocked and could carry a pending observation across undock/redock.
resolved_findings.resolution: All three actions require a docked cartridge. Undock consumes/discards pending observation; redocking requires a fresh command and verification.

package_tests.coverage: Contracts, stable groups/anchors, source labels, reuse accounting, isolated GLBs, image dimensions, allowlist, default flow hold, fixture acknowledgement, retention/isolation, observed clamp, lineage, calibration invalidation and stale-context protection; one-use clamp cycles, repeated switch rejection, fresh-cycle recovery, dock preconditions and undock/redock invalidation

task_lifecycle_comparison.scope: The scene implements a small static metadata guard. The task evaluator is an exact canonical-trace checker. This review does not assert full evaluator parity, observation authentication or persistent replay protection.

nonblocking_observations: Some small labels and the qualification indicator are partially occluded in the overview. The close-up and editable scene provide better inspection; no essential blocked-pump/no-live-data warning is lost.
Fine base text on the volume display is smaller and lower-contrast than its main cards, but the three volume categories and values are clear and the explicit scale warning is present.
Pixel evidence predates metadata-only binding and export-isolation corrections. Generator inspection shows unchanged geometry, materials, cameras and lighting for the final native scenes.
limits: All dimensions, anchors, port placement and docking/grasp relationships are authored and unqualified. Metres and correct glTF axis conversion do not imply real-device fit or safety.

Default 40-fold flow conflict remains unresolved and all pump/physical acquisition requests raise holds. Fixture acknowledgement and metadata receipts are never scientific measurements or device permission.

The 22 uL chamber, approximately 300 pL optical region and unknown handling volume remain distinct. No internal source-shaped SPP, channel, optical path, fluid simulation or precision-as-accuracy claim is supplied.
Reuse is fifteen mesh parts across two pre-existing original families with zero new unique credit. Six semantic groups, repeated vials and multiple exports are not independent asset designs.
Review establishes what is visible in the supplied code, geometry, source fact contracts and exports; it is not a global plagiarism search or legal determination.
